title: Imperfetto or passato prossimo?
rule: The passato prossimo tells what happened: single, completed events that move the story forward, however long they lasted (ho lavorato dieci anni a Milano). The imperfetto tells how things were: habits, descriptions, states, and actions in progress when something else happened. Mentre goes with the imperfetto; quando usually introduces the passato prossimo event. Some verbs change meaning between the two: sapere, conoscere, volere, potere, dovere.

Imperfetto
Passato prossimo
rows: event, change, action with a beginning and end
any length, but closed: dieci minuti, dieci anni

blocks.caption: Verbs that change meaning
head: Verb
Imperfetto
Passato prossimo
rows: ho saputo = I found out, I heard
conoscevo = I knew, I was acquainted with
ho conosciuto = I met (for the first time)
ho voluto = I insisted on, I decided to; non ho voluto = I refused
potevo = I could, it was possible
ho potuto = I managed to; non ho potuto = I was unable to
dovevo = I was supposed to, I had to (in principle)
ho dovuto = I had to (and did)
c'è stato = there was (an event, a storm, a problem)
ho avuto = I got, I received, I had (an experience)

blocks.title: The English trap: one past, two in Italian
blocks.text: English says *I walked to school* for both the habit and the single trip. Italian will not let you: [[andavo]] for the habit, [[sono andato]] for the trip. And English says *it rained* for both the backdrop and the closed event; Italian: [[pioveva]] (while something happened) or [[ha piovuto]] (all night, and then stopped). Decide what you are showing, not how long it took.

items.t: Ieri sera ero stanco, così sono andato a letto alle nove. Mentre dormivo, Dora ha bussato.
items.n: Last night I was tired, so I went to bed at nine. While I was sleeping, Dora knocked.

items.t: Da bambino andavo in Italia ogni estate. Nel 2019 ci sono andato da solo per la prima volta.
items.n: As a child I went to Italy every summer. In 2019 I went by myself for the first time.

items.t: Non sapevo che Oronzo fosse il fratello. L'ho saputo domenica.
items.n: I didn't know Oronzo was the brother. I found out on Sunday.

items.t: Dovevo tornare a Toronto a settembre, ma non ho voluto.
items.n: I was supposed to go back to Toronto in September, but I refused.

items.wrong: Mentre ho dormito, Dora ha bussato.
Ieri andavo al mare e nuotavo e tornavo alle sei. (as a sequence of events)
items.right: Ieri sono andato al mare, ho nuotato e sono tornato alle sei.
items.why: A chain of completed actions: passato prossimo.

items.wrong: Ho conosciuto Dora da tre mesi.
items.right: Conosco Dora da tre mesi. / L'ho conosciuta tre mesi fa.
items.why: Ho conosciuto = I met; still-true knowing takes the present + da.

items.wrong: Quando ero in Italia, ho mangiato sempre bene. (fine, as a summary) · Quando andavo in Italia, ho mangiato bene. (odd)
items.right: Quando andavo in Italia, mangiavo bene.

items.wrong: Non potevo venire ieri. (I couldn't, in general) for "I wasn't able to make it"
items.why: A specific failed attempt: passato prossimo.

items.q: Ieri ___ (fare) caldo e ___ (esserci) molta gente al mare. Noi ___ (nuotare) tutto il pomeriggio e alle sette ___ (tornare) a casa. Mentre ___ (cenare), ___ (arrivare) Tommaso.
items.n: Yesterday it was hot and there were a lot of people at the sea. We swam all afternoon and at seven we went home. While we were having dinner, Tommaso arrived.

items.why: Ho conosciuto = I met for the first time.

items.q: I was about to leave when Dora called.
answers: Stavo per uscire quando Dora ha chiamato
